notes.title: Hotfix update
notes.content:
We have set a new build live to fix an issue where the game doesn't start when newly installed. This happened likely due to windows security updates that prevented the installation from finishing properly.

This should be fixed now.

If you experience issues with the game's sound, you can try to navigate to the game's install directory and open the file "soundfix.bat". This was a step that previously happened automatically as part of installation, but now has to be done manually to fix sound issues that can happen for some players.
